title: Dog Night, 2016 · before
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: The night before seventeen years: the pup at the alley's mouth stopping on his own, a night early, and looking back at Wood. He's learned the date, or the route, or the smell of the week. The strip doesn't decide which.

panels.composition: The street at night, the Lanes' sign with four letters dark. The PUP stopped at the alley's mouth, WOOD behind with the leash slack.
